extraction.Name: Ben Irving
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment of 320 acres, but was told that he would be forded to take it, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment, in 1919, for $3200.00, $1600.00 cash, and the other $1600.00 went in on a car deal
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: when he sold his place he paid the delinquemt taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: only source of income is what he can make as a day laborer
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife and three minor children to support; wife has poor health, being troubled with her heart, and one child is troubled with a bone disease; has never received any help from the County or Government; document reference No. 18; sworn November 17, 1928
